focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞：製造產出、貿易措施及機房基礎設施
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asia: manufacturing, trade measures and data center infrastructure

throughline.zh: 美方公布適用台灣與東南亞的關稅提案，新加坡製造數據與越泰新海纜公告，分別更新設備產出及區域網路建設進度。
throughline.en: A U.S. tariff proposal covers Taiwan and Southeast Asia, while Singapore’s manufacturing release and the VTS cable announcement update equipment output and regional network construction.

text.zh: 美方公布產能過剩 301 關稅提案，台灣擬最高 15%，扣除最惠國與既有 301 稅率，最終稅率及豁免仍待定。
text.en: The U.S. proposed a Taiwan tariff of up to 15%, net of most-favored-nation and existing Section 301 rates. Final rates and exemptions are pending.

text.zh: 新加坡 10 月製造業產出年增 6.1%，精密工程年增 54.1%，經發局指出半導體設備增產。
text.en: Singapore’s October manufacturing output rose 6.1%. Precision engineering gained 54.1%, with the EDB citing higher semiconductor equipment production.

text.zh: 金融時報報導輝達要求合作廠暫停向東南亞四國交付部分伺服器，訂單範圍和期限尚未獲業者公開確認。
text.en: The FT reported that Nvidia asked partners to pause some server shipments to four Southeast Asian markets. Companies have not publicly confirmed the scope or duration.

text.zh: 媒體引述川寶稱，桃園玻璃通孔與玻璃核心基板產線已於 11 月啟用，月產能 500 片，已取得五家客戶打樣訂單。
text.en: Chime-Ball told media that its Taoyuan glass substrate line started in November with monthly capacity of 500 panels and sample orders from five customers.

text.zh: Viettel 與 Singtel 主導的越泰新海纜動工，設計容量 600 Tbps，目標 2030 年第四季完工。
text.en: The Viettel and Singtel-led Vietnam–Thailand–Singapore cable broke ground, with 600 Tbps in design capacity and a Q4 2030 completion target.

title.zh: 美國公布產能過剩 301 關稅提案，台灣適用稅率擬最高 15%
title.en: U.S. proposes Taiwan tariff of up to 15% in Section 301 excess-capacity investigation

summary.zh: 美國貿易代表署 11 月 25 日於美國公布 14 個經濟體的產能過剩 301 調查結果及關稅提案，台灣所列稅率最高 15%，扣除最惠國稅率及現行 301 關稅，草案另列擬豁免品項。台灣行政院 11 月 26 日說明，書面意見收至 2027 年 1 月 5 日，公聽會自 1 月 25 日開始。
summary.en: The U.S. Trade Representative published findings and tariff proposals covering 14 economies on November 25. The Taiwan proposal sets a rate of up to 15%, net of most-favored-nation rates and existing Section 301 tariffs, and lists proposed exemptions. Taiwan’s Executive Yuan said on November 26 that comments are due January 5, 2027, with hearings beginning January 25.

text.zh: 台灣通知草案的附件列有部分電腦與處理單元的稅則號列，例如 8471.30.01 和 8471.50.01。判讀供應鏈適用範圍時，須對照貨品原產地、完整稅則號列及草案所列的適用限制。
text.en: The Taiwan annex lists certain computers and processing units, including HTSUS 8471.30.01 and 8471.50.01. Coverage turns on the country of origin, complete tariff classification and any scope limitation in the proposal.

text.zh: 美方另列馬來西亞、泰國、印尼與柬埔寨最高 18%，新加坡最高 20%，越南最高 35%。台灣通知也列出替代方案，若美方認為諮商及承諾未達要求，將考慮最高 25%，扣除既有 301 稅率並保留特定豁免。
text.en: The USTR proposed ceilings of 18% for Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Cambodia, 20% for Singapore, and 35% for Vietnam. It also outlined a Taiwan alternative of up to 25%, net of existing Section 301 tariffs and subject to exemptions, if it finds consultations and commitments unsatisfactory.

title.zh: 新加坡 10 月製造業產出年增 6.1%，精密工程年增 54.1%
title.en: Singapore October manufacturing output rises 6.1% as precision engineering grows 54.1%

summary.zh: 新加坡經濟發展局 11 月 26 日公布，10 月製造業產出年增 6.1%，9 月修正為年增 5.0%。精密工程產出年增 54.1%，當局指出機械與系統類別的半導體設備增產；電子業則年增 6.6%。
summary.en: Singapore’s Economic Development Board reported on November 26 that October manufacturing output rose 6.1% year over year after a revised 5.0% gain in September. Precision engineering output grew 54.1%, with the EDB citing increased semiconductor equipment production in machinery and systems. Electronics rose 6.6%.

text.zh: 新加坡統計局刊載的工業生產指數以 2025 年為 100，10 月為 120.6，9 月為 112.5。另一口徑的季節調整後月增率為 7.1%，排除生物醫藥製造後為 7.3%。
text.en: The Department of Statistics shows an industrial production index of 120.6 in October and 112.5 in September, with 2025 set to 100. On a seasonally adjusted basis, output rose 7.1% month on month, or 7.3% excluding biomedical manufacturing.

text.zh: 據經濟發展局初估，排除生物醫藥後，10 月產出年增 12.1%。同月化學品及一般製造分別年增 4.4% 和 0.5%，運輸工程與生物醫藥製造分別年減 5.3% 和 35.8%。
text.en: The EDB’s preliminary figures put year-over-year growth excluding biomedical manufacturing at 12.1%. Chemicals rose 4.4% and general manufacturing 0.5%. Transport engineering fell 5.3% and biomedical manufacturing 35.8%.

title.zh: 金融時報報導輝達要求合作廠暫停向東南亞四國交付部分伺服器
title.en: FT reports Nvidia instructed partners to pause some server shipments to four Southeast Asian markets

summary.zh: 金融時報 11 月 26 日引述知情人士報導，輝達據稱要求製造合作夥伴暫停向馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國與印尼交付搭載其晶片的伺服器。報導點名戴爾與 Supermicro，受影響的訂單範圍和暫停期限尚無公開說法。
summary.en: The Financial Times reported on November 26, citing people familiar with the matter, that Nvidia had told manufacturing partners to pause shipments of servers containing its chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. The report named Dell and Supermicro. The order scope and duration remain unconfirmed.

text.zh: 金融時報稱，接到通知的是向合作廠下單的買方。路透轉述金融時報內容，並表示輝達、戴爾及 Supermicro 未立即回覆置評。
text.en: The FT said buyers that placed orders with manufacturing partners had been notified. Reuters reported the FT account and said Nvidia, Dell and Supermicro did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

text.zh: 11 月 25 日刊登的美國《聯邦公報》另有針對七家實體的出口許可規則，依目的地列入馬來西亞、新加坡與泰國。四國出貨消息出自媒體所述的合作廠通知，涵蓋範圍與美國列名規則各有其來源。
text.en: The U.S. Federal Register separately published an export licensing rule on November 25 for seven entities listed under Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand. The reported four-country shipment pause comes from accounts of supplier notices and has a different scope from the Entity List rule.

title.zh: 川寶稱桃園玻璃通孔及玻璃核心基板產線啟用，取得五家客戶打樣訂單
title.en: Chime-Ball says Taoyuan glass substrate line has started, with sample orders from five customers

summary.zh: 鉅亨網 11 月 25 日引述川寶科技指出，桃園蘆竹的玻璃通孔與玻璃核心基板代工線當月已投入營運，產能為每月 500 片面板級基板。公司稱已取得五家客戶的打樣訂單，規劃 2027 年初展開樣品驗證及製程優化。
summary.en: Anue reported on November 25 that Chime-Ball Technology said its through-glass via and glass core substrate line in Luzhu, Taoyuan, had begun operations that month, with capacity of 500 panel-level substrates a month. The company cited sample orders from five customers and plans for validation and process refinement in early 2027.

text.zh: 據公司向媒體說明，產線處理 510 mm × 515 mm 基板，涵蓋雷射微孔、濕式蝕刻、鈦銅濺鍍、銅金屬化填孔及光學和 X 光檢查。川寶的產品頁另列同尺寸範圍的玻璃通孔自動光學檢測設備。
text.en: The company told media that the line processes 510 mm by 515 mm panels using laser drilling, wet etching, titanium and copper sputtering, copper filling and optical and X-ray inspection. Its product documentation separately lists an automated optical inspection system for glass of the same dimensions.

text.zh: 鉅亨網與知新聞引述川寶稱，蘆竹廠有約 600 坪無塵室，整合 12 道關鍵製程。打樣客戶來自玻璃材料、載板及面板產業。
text.en: Anue and KNews reported that Chime-Ball cited a roughly 600-ping cleanroom and 12 process steps. Sample customers span glass materials, substrates and display panels.

title.zh: Viettel 與 Singtel 主導越泰新海纜動工，設計容量 600 Tbps
title.en: Viettel and Singtel-led Vietnam, Thailand and Singapore cable starts construction with 600 Tbps design

summary.zh: 越南 Viettel 與新加坡 Singtel 主導的聯盟 11 月 26 日在越南胡志明市為 VTS 海纜動土，計畫連接越南、泰國與新加坡，總長約 2,500 公里，設計容量 600 Tbps。越南政府公布的目標完工期為 2030 年第四季。
summary.en: A consortium led by Vietnam’s Viettel and Singapore’s Singtel broke ground in Ho Chi Minh City on November 26 for the VTS submarine cable. The planned route links Vietnam, Thailand and Singapore over about 2,500 km, with design capacity of 600 Tbps and a Q4 2030 completion target.

text.zh: 越南政府指出，越南至新加坡主段約 1,200 公里，設計容量 240 Tbps，施工承包商為 NEC 與 ASEAN Cableship。其他參與者包括泰國 AIS、越南 VNPT、FPT Telecom 與 Viettel IDC。
text.en: The Vietnamese government put the Vietnam to Singapore segment at about 1,200 km and 240 Tbps, with NEC and ASEAN Cableship as contractors. Other partners include Thailand’s AIS and Vietnam’s VNPT, FPT Telecom and Viettel IDC.

text.zh: 泰國 AIS 於 11 月 25 日公告，董事會核准由子公司透過合資平台投資，並把區域機房、雲端與企業資料連線列為應用。海纜設計容量衡量光纖傳輸能力，機房用電或 IT 負載須另看個別設施資料。
text.en: Thailand’s AIS disclosed on November 25 that its board approved a subsidiary investment through a joint venture, citing data centers, cloud services and enterprise connectivity. The cable design measures data transmission capacity. Site power and IT load are separate facility figures.

title.zh: 德國 Wevo 在新加坡大士啟用電子材料工廠，公布投資逾 1,000 萬歐元
title.en: German materials maker Wevo opens Tuas electronics chemicals plant with investment of over €10 million

summary.zh: 德國特用化學品廠 Wevo 11 月 25 日在新加坡大士工業區啟用新廠，公布投資逾 1,000 萬歐元，並稱已開始生產電子灌封材料、黏著劑及密封材料。公司列出的應用包括感測器、控制單元、電池管理系統及充電設備。
summary.en: German specialty chemicals maker Wevo opened its plant in Singapore’s Tuas industrial area on November 25, citing investment of more than €10 million. It said production had begun for electronics potting compounds, adhesives and sealants used in products including sensors, control units, battery management systems and charging equipment.

text.zh: Wevo 公告列有聚氨酯、環氧樹脂及矽膠配方，用於保護電子零組件。廠房已完成實驗室裝設、製程驗證與首批樣品寄送，公司稱接下來將調升產量。
text.en: Wevo lists polyurethane, epoxy and silicone formulations for protecting electronic components. It said it had commissioned labs, verified processes and dispatched initial samples, with a production ramp to follow.

text.zh: 新加坡經濟發展局支持設廠。Wevo 將長期新增職缺估為最多 50 個，未公布目前人力規模。
text.en: The Singapore Economic Development Board supported the project. Wevo said the plant could create up to 50 jobs over time and did not give current headcount.

title.zh: 研華在德國 SPS 說明半導體邊緣檢測與軟體定義控制方案
title.en: Advantech presents edge inspection and software-defined control at SPS in Germany

summary.zh: 台灣研華 11 月 25 日在德國紐倫堡 SPS 國際自動化展期間，公布用於半導體等高資料量場景的 GPU 加速資料擷取與分析方案。研華也說明把工業人機介面與 Bosch Rexroth 等合作夥伴的控制技術整合。
summary.en: Taiwan’s Advantech announced GPU-accelerated data acquisition and analytics for data-intensive inspection, including semiconductor manufacturing, at SPS in Nuremberg on November 25. It also described integrating industrial operator interfaces with control technologies from partners including Bosch Rexroth.

text.zh: 研華表示，自動化方案結合即時控制、工業通訊、人機介面及邊緣運算。公司列出的展出內容也涵蓋 NVIDIA 技術上的機器人運算、感知與軟體控制。
text.en: Advantech said its automation platform combines real-time control, industrial communications, operator interfaces and edge computing. It also listed robotics computing, perception and software control based on NVIDIA technologies.

text.zh: 主辦方 Mesago 公告展期為 11 月 24 日至 26 日。研華公布展位在第 7 館 380 號。
text.en: Organizer Mesago lists November 24 to 26 as the show dates. Advantech identified its stand as Hall 7, Booth 380.

title.zh: Singtel 與新加坡 GovTech 簽署備忘錄，擬在 One Comcentre 部署樓宇控制平台
title.en: Singtel and GovTech sign MOU for a building automation platform at One Comcentre

summary.zh: 新加坡 Singtel 與政府科技局 11 月 26 日簽署合作備忘錄，規劃在烏節路區的 One Comcentre 導入開放數位平台。雙方將以共用介面連接樓宇系統、感測器及機器人，並列出設施維護與能源管理為探索用途。
summary.en: Singtel and GovTech Singapore signed a memorandum on November 26 to deploy an Open Digital Platform at the One Comcentre development in the Orchard Road district. They plan shared interfaces for building controls, sensors and robots, with facilities maintenance and energy management among the uses to explore.

text.zh: 開放數位平台由 GovTech 與 JTC 共同開發。GovTech 公告稱，Singtel 計畫加入 5G+ 網路切片，使各應用可依延遲和連線品質需求使用不同網路配置。
text.en: GovTech and JTC co-developed the platform. GovTech said Singtel plans to add 5G+ network slicing so applications can use different connectivity settings according to latency and service requirements.

text.zh: One Comcentre 預計 2028 年底完工。公告列入主動維護及配送、清潔等自動化服務，這些應用仍屬雙方規劃。
text.en: One Comcentre is scheduled for completion by the end of 2028. Proactive maintenance, automated delivery and cleaning are among the functions the partners plan to explore.

question.zh: 提案中的 15% 如何與既有稅率及豁免一起讀？
question.en: How does the 15% proposal relate to existing rates and exemptions?

text.zh: 美方擬議台灣稅率最高 15%，並從擬議稅率扣除適用的最惠國及 301 稅率，特定品項擬豁免。草案另外列了條件不同的 25% 替代方案。
text.en: The stated 15% Taiwan ceiling is net of most-favored-nation and existing Section 301 rates, with proposed product exemptions. The draft also presents a conditional 25% alternative.

question.zh: 新加坡 6.1% 與 7.1% 各在比較什麼？

text.zh: 6.1% 是 10 月相對去年同月，7.1% 是本月與上月的季節調整後增幅。兩者都是產出統計，觀察期間不同。
text.en: The 6.1% compares October with the same month a year earlier. The 7.1% compares it with September after seasonal adjustment.

question.zh: VTS 的 600 Tbps 與 240 Tbps 涵蓋哪些範圍？
question.en: What do the 600 Tbps and 240 Tbps VTS figures cover?

text.zh: 600 Tbps 是連接越南、泰國與新加坡的全線設計容量。240 Tbps 是越南至新加坡段的設計容量。
text.en: The 600 Tbps covers the full three-country system. The 240 Tbps applies to the Vietnam to Singapore segment.

verificationNote.zh: 301 稅率與豁免仍屬提案。輝達出貨限制只見媒體引述，川寶的實際開線日、客戶驗收與量產量也未公開。
verificationNote.en: The Section 301 rates and exemptions remain proposals. The reported Nvidia shipment pause is source-limited. Chime-Ball has not disclosed its exact startup date, customer acceptance or volume production.
